notes.title: Happy New Year From Kagura Games!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/e3b1afb5dedb48f4b2f69d7fd98a64e0db79ba8c.jpg

Greetings everyone,

The new year is upon us and we want to take a moment to wish everyone a happy new year and thank you for all the support during 2021.

We are very grateful to all of our fans and 2022 will be a big year for us. We hope you are all looking forward to our upcoming game projects and more that will take your breath away!

The wonderful illustration featured at the top of this post is drawn by developer GapTax and features characters from his game RaiOhGar: Asuka and the King of Steel.

Don't forget to also follow us on our Steam Publisher page and check out our Winter Sale 2021 which is live for a few more days. You can find up to 60% off on most of our games during the sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227890/Summer_Memories/

Flode

An up-and-coming priestess for the God of Light, Leight. She's kind and caring to a fault and staunchly devoted to her god.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/ef316d225169c51753576a936d72c2b92919092b.png

Volze

Volze is the chairman of Big Bucks Business. There's only one thing he truly cares about: making big bucks. He deals in all kinds of trade going in and out of Cerbes Island, including some that may be... on the more questionable side of things.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/865ce911487c040831581734518ddb475d19c745.png

Noir

Noir is a mysterious being, one with ties to the old faith in Cerbes Island. She has a very playful and teasing personality and seems to wish for Flode to do something for her. But what could it lead to...?

notes.title: Princess Project Character Spotlight
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/4f65f4788305058fb1ee852127a849040214457b.png

Today we will be taking a look at some of the wonderful characters from Princess Project by Triangle which is currently 15% off during our Winter 2019 Sale!

The game focuses on Princess Meeyu who is tasked with an important job of fulfilling her father's royal duties after he injured his back. She has a very poor reputation so she has to work hard to prove to her people that she is a worthy successor.

Meeyu

The daughter of King Ailuref who’s known for being empty-headed and extremely klutzy, earning her the reputation of being “the Useless Princess” within the kingdom. She’s rather delighted about being given the chance to govern the kingdom and is eager to prove herself as a capable ruler. Judging by her comically low support rates however, it’s evident that the rest of Ailuref do not share her enthusiasm…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35284351/4ba2e22ccf09ca58aa82b4ba4f1ea2170d8b1321.png

Elise

The head maid of the palace. She’s rather snarky towards people and never hesitates to mock Meeyu for her nonsensical behaviors when they occur. Nevertheless, she is still quite loyal towards Meeyu, and is always on the lookout for her.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35284351/920ff232db6163d0e3d39439b1e5c4105d384ea5.png

Sonia

A nun from the local church. She’s rather innocent and clueless about the evils in the world due to her sheltered lifestyle. Unfortunately, this only makes her a more enticing target for the sexual deviants around her…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35284351/a56e2b07aab51dae319e6f6fc19d522eb6cbc16f.png

Check out Princess Project on Steam today while it's 15% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1106080/Princess_Project/

各位玩家们大家好：

近期由于Steam平台出现异常，造成了部分玩家的游戏文字内容出现乱码与语言不正常等现象，对此我们深感遗憾。在Steam修复该bug之前，您可以尝试通过以下方法修复您的游戏：

1. 

·备份存档
·检查完整性（会清除已经打上的补丁）
·在steam设置中将游戏语言改为英文，并等待游戏更新完毕
·在steam设置中将游戏语言改回简体中文，并等待游戏更新完毕
·重新下载补丁并安装

或者

2. 前往我们的网站（[url=]kaguragamer.com 或 [url=]kagurafan.com）下载并安装最新的语言修复补丁


如果问题还未解决，请加入我们的官方QQ群671989771咨询管理员进行修复。

谢谢您的支持与理解。

notes.title: Holy Knight Luviria Character Spotlight
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/608369ebc5be4310c2b17535fa97fe907ed92227.png

With the release of Holy Knight Luviria nearing, we've decided that now is a good time to spotlight some of the characters from the game. Holy Knight Luviria is scheduled to release on November 15, so don't forget to wishlist the game to prepare for the release!

Luviria

A righteous paladin and captain of the Crimson Holy Knight Order, a unit formed with the goal of the subjugation of the demon armies in mind. She is a close friend of Fonica, the current Jewel of the Divine. With another all-out war with the demons on the horizon, Luviria has taken the initiative to strike deep into the demonic domain with her brigade, determined to stop the conflict before it occurs.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/c0bd4749319358a8033b4892805ad40d5632f23d.png

Fonica

The current Jewel of the Divine – a bloodline of saints who wield enormous power. A kind and gentle woman who is a tad overly protective of others and hates making others put themselves in danger for her. Due to her importance, she is effectively confined within a glorified prison cell at all times by her superiors to keep her out of reach from the ill-intentioned demons.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/6b316098a97d44dfa37a3e00a368164c7c3a979c.png

Iris

Voice’s younger sister. A succubus who possesses the power to drain her partners until they drop dead via sexual intercourse. She’s equally as twisted as Voice and just as much a sexual maniac as him. She’s also very supportive of Voice despite her occasional sassiness towards him, and will always stay on his side no matter how dire the situation gets.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/2ae0f2447c2ce0c5fbf8f8f5f06523570fc94625.png

Lifria

The half-human witch who is head over heels in love with Voice. She’s unwaveringly loyal to Voice and refuses to have relations with any demons other than him, even though choosing to stay with only one partner goes against the norm in demon society.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/16b46529a96898066bda37ed731ea35743f5f474.png

Tia

A powerful demon with the ability to negate holy attributes. Formerly serving Voice’s father Shout, she is loyal only to the dethroned Demon King and is uncooperative towards Voice. For unknown reasons, she seems to harbor deep hatred against the Jewel bloodline and is hellbent on killing Fonica, who is its current descendant.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/3fbb5faf09498d45df6a689f6c7f08871d4984b6.png

We hope you are looking forward to this release!

She's a member of the trinity, belonging to Squad 6. She hates men, which is why she most often chooses to act with Konoha.

Her haircut and mannerisms are boyish, and her approach to life is laid-back. She likes to hang out with anyone, making her popular among boys and girls.

She's an incredible beauty with blonde hair and blue eyes born in America and raised in Tokyo. While normally calm, if you anger her, you'll regret it.

She's the biggest weirdo of the trinity. All she focuses on is researching.
